g.text: The J++ part zeroed at one layer: the recall keeps its answers
Main test (two people swap picks), on the changed prompt: at the bridge word, at one layer, the
J++ part's 25 directions, or a random part (same size), taken out of its state. Answers kept (%), 95%
intervals, fixed in advance. Rule: followed if ≥ 80 kept, within 10 of random; needed if ≥ 30 below
